prompt.name: Director: First Video
prompt.description: Generate your first short-form video from a single sentence idea. Writes a script, picks B-roll, and renders.

stages.name: Write script
stages.prompt: Write a 30-second vertical video script for the topic provided. 5–7 punchy beats. No filler.

stages.name: Choose visuals
stages.prompt: For each beat, suggest one b-roll shot description and one on-screen caption.

stages.name: Render
stages.prompt: Assemble the script and visuals into a 9:16 video at 30fps with captions.
